name: code-maps
description: Maps of a codebase as navigable HTML pages, built from what the code compiles to and does rather than from reading it. Ships java-diagrams: class and package diagrams for a Java project, read from bytecode, cross-checked against jdeps, every view verified against the extracted graph and bounded so it stays readable. And execution-trace: a run trace that follows one execution from the command line to its last effect, step by step like a debugger, redrawn through layers (process, code, state, data, disk), with excerpts cut from the source at build time, call arrows read from bytecode and classes filtered by a measured class-load log.
